fact: In its 6 July 2026 country statement to the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance, Tanzania lists, among governance frameworks it is 'developing', a National AI Strategy Framework (2026); the statement gives no adoption, body or funding.
The Citizen reported that a National AI Strategy was under development and expected to be released later in 2025, as the first National AI Forum ended on 29 July 2025.
CIPIT states Tanzania is currently developing its National AI Strategy and lacks a dedicated AI law; the document gives no event date, so its publication date of 2026-09-15 is used.
